scope: Source-reported recording-count and manifestation provenance only; no participant audio or transcript ingestion

paper_manifestation.title: MunTTS: A Text-to-Speech System for Mundari

discrepancy.interpretation_not_permitted: Do not label either source erroneous and do not silently normalize the counts until an authoritative version/curation explanation is verified.

permitted_evidence.statement: The 2024 MunTTS paper reports 26,868 recordings, while the current Karya dataset repository reports 26,870 and provides a repository SHA1 for the full archive; the two-count difference is retained explicitly rather than silently reconciled.
permitted_evidence.use_constraint: Attribute each count to its respective manifestation. The repository-provided SHA1 is provenance metadata, not an MLHKP-computed checksum.

release_value: Turns a release blocker into an explicit, exact-locator version/manifestation discrepancy record and prevents accidental count conflation while participant and cultural-access gates remain closed.
